outlet: WA Secretary of State election results, precinct export
notes: Kittitas County precinct results, November 8, 2022 general (48 precincts, 50 reporting units with the split units 'DRY CREEK(*)' and 'ROSLYN(*)'). 'Kittitas Commissioner 3' (Brett Wachsmith 13,804, unopposed) and 'PUBLIC UTILITY DISTRICT 1 Commissioner 3' (Joe O'Leary 12,399) appear in all 48 precincts (county-wide electorates). The District Court races are split: 'LOWER COUNTY DISTRICT COURT District Court Judge' on 35 units (Paul Sander 9,195, unopposed) and 'UPPER COUNTY DISTRICT COURT District Court Judge' on 15 units (Craig Juris 2,704, Eileen Murphy Young 2,463), the Upper set being the Cle Elum/Roslyn/Easton/Hyak precincts of the county code's Upper Kittitas County District Court list (Swauk appears in both lists).
